title: 第23章 九阴聚尸窟长生宝鉴第24章 杀妖手段杀你也凑合
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: “这话听着解气。”
赵平在一旁笑出两排白牙。
在他看来，无论是说话做事，陆大人都占着理儿。
镇魔卫就是斩妖除魔的，凭什么这妖女与你徐直有瓜葛，就得晾着等你来杀？
这中间得耽误多少事？
你一个镇魔校尉承担得起？
杨林和李青也跟着点头，单是养尸杀人这一条就定斩不饶。
你徐直心有执念不假，但总不能拿别人的命来迁就吧？
“大人，回去我就查这徐直的底子。”
苏定安只说了这一句话。
虽说他才跟了陆渊两天，但也知道这位陆大人不是怕事的人。
徐直要是想找麻烦，得先掂量掂量手中的剑够不够快，够不够狠。
陆大人这人杀伐果断，行事作风的确是狠辣了点。
但心里也装着一杆秤，该杀就杀，该放就放。
就算徐直找上门来，顶多也只是重伤，不会丢命。
当苍云岭阴云散尽之时，赤霞县北郊，一座废弃药铺之内烟雾缭绕。
正堂中央供奉着一尊青灰色的诡异神像。
神像呈蜷缩之姿，面容自眉心至下颌一分为二，左半边平静俊秀，右半边白骨狰狞。
神像脚踏枯骨莲台，背生六只手臂，有的下垂，有的合十，有的高举，有的撕扯。
在诡异神像前，一个身穿暗红色道袍的中年男人盘膝而坐，面前的青铜香炉燃着三炷黑香，烟雾扭曲上升。
门外传来急促脚步声，一个紫袍青年跌跌撞撞，扑通一声跪倒在地。
“神使，不好了，苍云岭那边出大事了！”
“镇魔司出动，刘韫和柳青丝二位副坛被杀，三名灰袍教徒身死，数十只尸傀被灭，就连山神庙下的那只千年尸魔......也被灭了！”
殷无极睁开双眼，眼珠呈琥珀色，瞳孔竖立，像蛇又像猫。
他慢条斯理地将手中念珠转了一圈，声音很轻。
“两个副坛，死就死了，千年尸魔，也无所谓......”
“可那处封印之下，有我长生教至宝镇尸铃！”
“这铜铃是首任教主祭炼的法器，内刻九九八十一道镇尸符文，用作大阵阵眼，镇尸千年而不朽。”
“若非那只血妖意外污了封印，就是再镇千年，尸魔也不会破封而出。”
殷无极转过身，看着那尊蜷缩在枯骨莲台上的诡异神像，声音听不出喜怒。
“本座入长生教二十年，从一个外门弟子做到四大神使，为的就是那枚镇尸铃。”
“让刘韫去养尸，不过是为了启出尸魔，拿回镇尸铃。”
“这铜铃是天下尸类妖魔的克星，有了它，就能进入九阴聚尸窟，取出三百年前尸解仙从我教窃走的那卷长生宝鉴。”
“宝鉴之内蕴有一门镇教神通，我长生教能否发扬光大，全在于此！”
殷无极转过身，琥珀色瞳孔终于有了波澜，声音变得冷硬如铁。
content_en:
"This sounds relieved."
Zhao Ping smiled on the side with two rows of white teeth.
In his opinion, Mr. Lu always has reason to speak and do things.
The Demon Suppressing Guard is supposed to slay demons. Why does this demon girl have to wait for you to kill her because she has something to do with you, Xu Zhi?
How many things will be delayed in the meantime?
Can you, a demon-suppressing captain, afford it?
Yang Lin and Li Qing also nodded. Just raising corpses and killing people would definitely kill them.
It’s true that you, Xu Zhixin, have obsessions, but you can’t compromise others’ lives, right?
"Sir, I will check Xu Zhi's background when I get back."
Su Ding'an only said this sentence.
Although he had only been with Lu Yuan for two days, he knew that Mr. Lu was not someone who was afraid of getting into trouble.
If Xu Zhi wants to cause trouble, he must first weigh whether the sword in his hand is fast enough and ruthless enough.
Mr. Lu is decisive in killing, and his behavior is indeed a bit ruthless.
But I also have a steelyard in my heart, and I will kill when I need to, and let go when I need to.
Even if Xu Zhi comes to the door, he will only be seriously injured at most and will not lose his life.
When the clouds cleared over Cangyun Ridge, smoke filled an abandoned pharmacy in the northern suburbs of Chixia County.
In the center of the main hall is a strange blue-grey statue of a god.
The statue is in a curled-up posture, and its face is divided into two parts from the eyebrows to the lower jaw. The left half is calm and handsome, and the right half is ferocious with white bones.
The statue stands on a lotus platform with dead bones, and has six arms on its back. Some are drooping, some are clasped together, some are raised high, and some are tearing apart.
In front of the strange statue, a middle-aged man wearing dark red robes sat cross-legged. The bronze incense burner in front of him was burning three sticks of black incense, and the smoke twisted and rose.
There were rapid footsteps outside the door, and a young man in purple robe stumbled and fell to his knees with a plop.
"God's envoy, it's bad, something big happened over there in Cangyun Ridge!"
"The Demon Suppressing Division was dispatched. The two assistants Liu Yun and Liu Qingsi were killed. Three gray-robed cultists were killed. Dozens of corpse puppets were destroyed. Even the thousand-year-old corpse demon under the mountain temple... was also destroyed!"
Yin Wuji opened his eyes, his eyes were amber, and his pupils were erect, like a snake or a cat.
He slowly turned the rosary in his hand in a circle and spoke softly.
"The two assistant altars will die if they die, and the thousand-year-old zombie demon doesn't matter..."
"But under that seal, there is the corpse-suppressing bell, the most precious treasure of my Immortality Sect!"
"This copper bell is a magical weapon refined by the first cult leader. It is engraved with ninety-nine and eighty-one corpse-suppressing runes. It can be used as a large formation eye to suppress corpses for thousands of years."
"If the blood demon hadn't accidentally defiled the seal, the corpse demon would not have broken out even if it were suppressed for a thousand years."
Yin Wuji turned around and looked at the strange statue curled up on the lotus platform with dead bones. There was no emotion or anger in his voice.
"I have been a member of the Immortality Religion for twenty years, and have risen from being an outer disciple to being one of the Four Divine Envoys, all for the sake of that corpse-suppressing bell."
"Let Liu Yun raise the corpse, just to arouse the corpse demon and get back the corpse suppressing bell."
"This copper bell is the nemesis of the zombie monsters in the world. With it, you can enter the Jiuyin Corpse Gathering Cave and take out the Book of Immortality that the Corpse Execution Immortal stole from our sect three hundred years ago."
"The treasure mirror contains a magical power to suppress religions. Whether our Immortality Sect can flourish depends entirely on this!"
Yin Wuji turned around, his amber pupils finally had waves, and his voice became as cold as iron.
